description: Grind settings for one grinder across every brew method. Use this for any question of the form "what grind should I use for my <grinder>", "what setting for French press on a <grinder>", or "how do I dial in my <grinder>". Returns the recommended setting and usable range for espresso, moka pot, AeroPress, pour over, siphon, steep-and-release (Clever Dripper, Hario Switch), drip, cupping, Chemex, French press and cold brew. When the user names a brew method, pass it as `method`: the answer then leads with that method, plus a starting recipe (ratio, dose, water temperature, time). The grinder can be named however the user said it.

grinder.description: Grinder name as the user said it, e.g. "Fellow Ode", "Baratza Encore", or a slug

method.description: Optional brew method the user asked about, as they said it: "V60", "pour over", "French press", "espresso", "AeroPress", "cold brew", "Chemex", "drip", "moka pot", "siphon", "Clever Dripper", "cupping"

roast.description: Optional roast level of the coffee the user is brewing. If they name a coffee rather than a roast ("Stumptown Hair Bender", "Lavazza Super Crema"), use what you know of it; leave out when unsure. Lighter roasts move the starting setting finer, darker ones coarser.

title: Grinder settings chart
